name: in.yaanmitra/travel
title: Yaanmitra: travel in India
description: Compare trains, buses, flights, cabs and rentals between Indian cities. Free, read-only.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Resolve a city, town or station/airport code in India to Yaanmitra place ids, with its state and whether it has an airport and a railway station. Use it when a name is ambiguous or misspelt, or to check whether a town has an airport or station. compare_trip and rental_options also accept plain names, so this is optional.

query.description: Place name, alias or code, e.g. "vizag", "Bengaluru", "NDLS"

tools.name: compare_trip
tools.description: Compare flights, trains, buses, outstation cabs, self-drive cars, rental bikes, rideshares and mixed routes between two places in India, read from travel sites' public pages. Returns options grouped by mode with the cheapest and fastest, departure/arrival times (India time), fares labelled "listed" (as on the site for that date) or "estimated", the source site of each, booking hand-off links, and notes (e.g. "Guntur has no airport — flights go via Vijayawada"). Usually instant from stored results; a route never searched before triggers a live search that can take up to a minute. Read-only; it never books anything.

from.description: Origin: a city/town name or Yaanmitra place id, e.g. "Delhi"

date.description: Travel date YYYY-MM-DD (India time). Leave out for the next available stored day (usually tomorrow).

tools.name: rental_options
tools.description: List scooters/motorbikes and self-drive cars on rent inside one city in India (e.g. Goa, Bengaluru, Manali), read from rental sites' public city pages (Royal Brothers, Rentrip, Sukuto, Revv and others). Prices are each site's tariff × days, estimated, before fuel and deposit; each listing has its site and a booking link. Use compare_trip instead for travel between two places.

city.description: City name or place id, e.g. "Goa"

kind.description: bike (scooters and motorbikes) or car (self-drive); leave out for both
